text_en: He left that place and went to the region of Judea and beyond the Jordan. And crowds again gathered around him; and, as was his custom, he again taught them.
text_cn: 耶稣从那里起身，来到犹太境界，约但河的对岸，群众又聚集到他那里，他又照常教训他们。

text_en: Some Pharisees came, and to test him they asked, “Is it lawful for a man to divorce his wife? ”
text_cn: 有些法利塞人前来问耶稣：许不许丈夫休妻？意思是要试探他。

text_en: He answered them, “What did Moses command you? ”
text_cn: 耶稣回答他们说：“梅瑟吩咐了你们什么？”

text_en: They said, “Moses allowed a man to write a certificate of dismissal and to divorce her. ”
text_cn: 他们说：“梅瑟准许了写休书休妻。”

text_en: But Jesus said to them, “Because of your hardness of heart he wrote this commandment for you.
text_cn: 耶稣对他们说：“这是为了你们的心硬，他才给你们写下了这条法令。

text_en: But from the beginning of creation, ‘God made them male and female. ’
text_cn: 但是，从创造之初，天主造了他们一男一女。

text_en: ‘For this reason a man shall leave his father and mother and be joined to his wife,
text_cn: 为此，人要离开他的父母，依附自己的妻子，

text_en: and the two shall become one flesh. ’ So they are no longer two, but one flesh.
text_cn: 二人成为一体，以致他们再不是两个，而是一体了。

text_en: Therefore what God has joined together, let no one separate. ”
text_cn: 所以，天主所结合的，人不可拆散。”

text_en: Then in the house the disciples asked him again about this matter.
text_cn: 回到家里，门徒又问他这事，

text_en: He said to them, “Whoever divorces his wife and marries another commits adultery against her;
text_cn: 耶稣对他们说：“谁若休自己的妻子而另娶，就是犯奸淫，辜负妻子；

text_en: and if she divorces her husband and marries another, she commits adultery. ”
text_cn: 若妻子离弃自己的丈夫而另嫁，也是犯奸淫。”

text_en: People were bringing little children to him in order that he might touch them; and the disciples spoke sternly to them.
text_cn: 有人给耶稣领来一些小孩子，要他抚摸他们；门徒却斥责他们。

text_en: But when Jesus saw this, he was indignant and said to them, “Let the little children come to me; do not stop them; for it is to such as these that the kingdom of God belongs.
text_cn: 耶稣见了，就生了气，对他们说：“让小孩子到我跟前来，不要阻止他们！因为天主的国正属于这样的人。

text_en: Truly I tell you, whoever does not receive the kingdom of God as a little child will never enter it. ”
text_cn: 我实在告诉你们：谁若不像小孩子一样接受天主的国，决不能进去。”

text_en: And he took them up in his arms, laid his hands on them, and blessed them.
text_cn: 耶稣遂抱起他们来，给他们覆手，祝福了他们。

text_en: As he was setting out on a journey, a man ran up and knelt before him, and asked him, “Good Teacher, what must I do to inherit eternal life? ”
text_cn: 正在耶稣出来行路时，跑来了一个人，跪在他面前，问他说：“善师，为承受永生，我该作什么？”

text_en: Jesus said to him, “Why do you call me good? No one is good but God alone.
text_cn: 耶稣对他说：“你为什么称我善？除了天主一个外，没有谁是善的。

text_en: You know the commandments: ‘You shall not murder; You shall not commit adultery; You shall not steal; You shall not bear false witness; You shall not defraud; Honor your father and mother. ’”
text_cn: 诫命你都知道：不可杀人，不可奸淫，不可偷盗，不可做假见证，不可欺诈，应孝敬你的父母。”

text_en: He said to him, “Teacher, I have kept all these since my youth. ”
text_cn: 他回答耶稣说：“师傅！这一切我从小就都遵守了。”

text_en: Jesus, looking at him, loved him and said, “You lack one thing; go, sell what you own, and give the money to the poor, and you will have treasure in heaven; then come, follow me. ”
text_cn: 耶稣定睛看他，就喜爱他，对他说：“你还缺少一样：你去，变卖你所有的一切，施舍给穷人，你必有宝藏在天上，然后来，背着十字架，跟随我！”

text_en: When he heard this, he was shocked and went away grieving, for he had many possessions.
text_cn: 因了这话，那人就面带愁容，忧郁地走了，因为他有许多产业。

text_en: Then Jesus looked around and said to his disciples, “How hard it will be for those who have wealth to enter the kingdom of God! ”
text_cn: 耶稣周围一看，对自己的门徒说：“那些有钱财的人，进天主的国是多么难啊！”

text_en: And the disciples were perplexed at these words. But Jesus said to them again, “Children, how hard it is to enter the kingdom of God!
text_cn: 门徒就都惊奇他这句话。耶稣又对他们说：“孩子们！仗恃钱财的人，进天主的国是多么难啊！

text_en: It is easier for a camel to go through the eye of a needle than for someone who is rich to enter the kingdom of God. ”
text_cn: 骆驼穿过针孔，比富有的人进天主的国还容易。”

text_en: They were greatly astounded and said to one another, “Then who can be saved? ”
text_cn: 他们就更加惊奇，彼此说：“这样，谁还能得救？”

text_en: Jesus looked at them and said, “For mortals it is impossible, but not for God; for God all things are possible. ”
text_cn: 耶稣注视他们说：“在人不可能，在天主却不然，因为在天主，一切都是可能的。”

text_en: Peter began to say to him, “Look, we have left everything and followed you. ”
text_cn: 伯多禄开口对他说：“看，我们舍弃了一切，而跟随了你。”

text_en: Jesus said, “Truly I tell you, there is no one who has left house or brothers or sisters or mother or father or children or fields, for my sake and for the sake of the good news,
text_cn: 耶稣回答说：“我实在告诉你们：人为了我，为了福音，而舍弃了房屋、或兄弟、或姊妹、或母亲、或父亲、或儿女、或田地，

text_en: who will not receive a hundredfold now in this age—houses, brothers and sisters, mothers and children, and fields, with persecutions—and in the age to come eternal life.
text_cn: 没有不在今时就得百倍的房屋、兄弟、姊妹、母亲、儿女、田地──连迫害也在内，并在来世获得永生的。

text_en: But many who are first will be last, and the last will be first. ”
text_cn: 但有许多在先的，要成为在后的；在后的，要成为在先的。”

text_en: They were on the road, going up to Jerusalem, and Jesus was walking ahead of them; they were amazed, and those who followed were afraid. He took the twelve aside again and began to tell them what was to happen to him,
text_cn: 那时，他们在路上，要上耶路撒冷去，耶稣在门徒前头走，他们都惊奇，跟随的人也都害怕。 耶稣又把那十二人带到一边，开始告诉他们那将要临到他身上的事：

text_en: saying, “See, we are going up to Jerusalem, and the Son of Man will be handed over to the chief priests and the scribes, and they will condemn him to death; then they will hand him over to the Gentiles;
text_cn: “看，我们上耶路撒冷去，人子要被交于司祭长和经师；他们要定他的死罪，要把他交给外邦人；

text_en: they will mock him, and spit upon him, and flog him, and kill him; and after three days he will rise again. ”
text_cn: 这些人要戏弄他，唾污他，鞭打他，杀害他；但三天以后，他必要复活。”

text_en: James and John, the sons of Zebedee, came forward to him and said to him, “Teacher, we want you to do for us whatever we ask of you. ”
text_cn: 载伯德的儿子雅各伯和若望走到耶稣跟前，对他说：“师傅！我们愿你允许我们的要求！”

text_en: And he said to them, “What is it you want me to do for you? ”
text_cn: 耶稣对他们说：“你们愿意我给你们做什么？”

text_en: And they said to him, “Grant us to sit, one at your right hand and one at your left, in your glory. ”
text_cn: 他们回答说：“赐我们在你的光荣中，一个坐在你右边，一个坐在你左边。”

text_en: But Jesus said to them, “You do not know what you are asking. Are you able to drink the cup that I drink, or be baptized with the baptism that I am baptized with? ”
text_cn: 耶稣对他们说：“你们不知道你们所求的是什么；你们能饮我饮的爵吗？或者，你们能受我受的洗吗？”

text_en: They replied, “We are able. ” Then Jesus said to them, “The cup that I drink you will drink; and with the baptism with which I am baptized, you will be baptized;
text_cn: 他们对他说：“我们能。”耶稣就对他们说：“我饮的爵，你们必要饮；我受的洗，你们必要受；

text_en: but to sit at my right hand or at my left is not mine to grant, but it is for those for whom it has been prepared. ”
text_cn: 但坐在我右边或左边，不是我可以给的，而是给谁预备了，就给谁。”

text_en: When the ten heard this, they began to be angry with James and John.
text_cn: 那十个听了，就开始恼怒雅各伯和若望。

text_en: So Jesus called them and said to them, “You know that among the Gentiles those whom they recognize as their rulers lord it over them, and their great ones are tyrants over them.
text_cn: 耶稣叫门徒过来，对他们说：“你们知道：在外邦人中，有尊为首领的，主宰他们，有大臣管辖他们；

text_en: But it is not so among you; but whoever wishes to become great among you must be your servant,
text_cn: 但你们中间，却不可这样：谁若愿意在你们中间成为大的，就当作你们的仆役；

text_en: and whoever wishes to be first among you must be slave of all.
text_cn: 谁若愿意在你们中间为首，就当作众人的奴仆，

text_en: For the Son of Man came not to be served but to serve, and to give his life a ransom for many. ”
text_cn: 因为人子，不是来受服事，而是来服事人，并交出自己的性命，为大众作赎价。”

text_en: They came to Jericho. As he and his disciples and a large crowd were leaving Jericho, Bartimaeus son of Timaeus, a blind beggar, was sitting by the roadside.
text_cn: 他们来到了耶里哥。耶稣和他的门徒及一大群人，从耶里哥出来的时候，有一个瞎眼的乞丐，即提买的儿子巴尔提买坐在路旁。

text_en: When he heard that it was Jesus of Nazareth, he began to shout out and say, “Jesus, Son of David, have mercy on me! ”
text_cn: 他一听说是纳匝肋人耶稣，就喊叫说：“耶稣，达味之子，可怜我罢！”

text_en: Many sternly ordered him to be quiet, but he cried out even more loudly, “Son of David, have mercy on me! ”
text_cn: 有许多人就斥责他，叫他不要作声；但他越发喊叫说：“达味之子，可怜我罢！”

text_en: Jesus stood still and said, “Call him here. ” And they called the blind man, saying to him, “Take heart; get up, he is calling you. ”
text_cn: 耶稣就站住说：“叫他过来！”人就叫那瞎子，给他说：“放心！起来！他叫你呢！”

text_en: So throwing off his cloak, he sprang up and came to Jesus.
text_cn: 瞎子就扔下自己的外衣，跳起来，走到耶稣跟前。

text_en: Then Jesus said to him, “What do you want me to do for you? ” The blind man said to him, “My teacher, let me see again. ”
text_cn: 耶稣对他说：“你愿意我给你做什么？”瞎子说：“师傅！叫我看见！”

text_en: Jesus said to him, “Go; your faith has made you well. ” Immediately he regained his sight and followed him on the way.
text_cn: 耶稣对他说：“去罢！你的信德救了你。”瞎子立刻看见了，就在路上跟着耶稣去了。
